phase_name: Interactive Workflow Decision-Selection Command and Contract Repair
recommended_next_phase: 145G.2V -- Interactive Workflow Decision-Selection Contract and Implementation Independent Verification. This recommendation does not authorize 145G.2V, 145G.3, or 145H.
summary: Closes Phase 145G.1's disclosed Blocking finding F-145G.1-1 by adding decision-session select (IWPC-001 revised v1.1 -> v1.2, IWPC-REQ-192-196) and repairing generate_preview's pre-existing failure to transition DecisionSelected -> AwaitingConfirmation on first Preview construction (a defect against already-frozen IWC-001/IWPC-REQ-018 text, discovered during this phase's own required re-derivation, not a new contract gap). Session gains a new with_decision_capture(...) domain mutator; SessionApplicationService gains select_decision(...), combining the EvidenceReady -> AwaitingDecision and AwaitingDecision -> DecisionSelected hops in one invocation when starting from EvidenceReady (mirroring submit_evidence's own Phase 145G.1 single-invocation precedent), or performing only the second hop when a session is already AwaitingDecision. select is single-use and fail-closed (no idempotent-replay path, mirroring record_confirmation's precedent), takes no separate identity flag (the selecting principal is the session's own bound owner_identity, mirroring confirm's precedent), and validates the selected option against the caller-declared --options-presented closed set (a new InvalidSelectionError, auto-mapped through the existing error taxonomy -- no new error_type or exit code was needed). The full chain create -> evidence -> select -> preview -> confirm -> readiness -> governance-record publish -> replay is now reachable through production CLI commands alone, verified by a real subprocess smoke test and 28 new tests (tests/test_phase_145g2_decision_selection_cli_repair.py), including a fully bridge-free end-to-end scenario. Discloses a new, deliberately out-of-scope, Non-Blocking finding F-145G.2-1: no command transitions AwaitingDecision -> AwaitingClarification (clarify only answers a clarification already open), a different operation from decision selection this phase's own governing prompt did not authorize; does not block this phase's own exit criteria since the happy path never requires clarify. All 44 pre-existing Phase 145G.1 tests pass unmodified. See docs/PHASE_145G2_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_DECISION_SELECTION_COMMAND_AND_CONTRACT_REPAIR.md.
self_correction: During manual end-to-end verification (before writing any test), confirm failed with invalid_state_transition even after select correctly reached DecisionSelected, because generate_preview never transitioned the session further. This was independently re-derived as a second, previously-undisclosed defect (not named by F-145G.1-1's own text) and repaired within this same phase, rather than declaring the phase blocked or silently expanding scope without disclosure -- documented explicitly in this phase's own re-derivation section and canonical report rather than folded silently into the select command's own changes.
